{{Quote|Message to spacers approaching Ralltiir: An Imperial blockade is being enforced in this system. No commercial starships have clearance to approach the planet. Ships defying this blockade will be engaged and destroyed by Imperial Naval vessels.|[[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] [[METOSP/Legends|METOSP]]|<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] established a '''blockade''' of the entire [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]]. The blockade was ordered by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]] and followed the violent [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|subjugation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] and the disbanding of the [[Ralltiiri High Council]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GNN3" /><ref name="CatCW" /> The blockade was so tight that Tion denied commercial starships,<ref name="PSG" /> as well as relief organizations access to the planet,<ref name="GNN3" /> at the risk of being destroyed by Imperial starships.<ref name="PSG" /> Even the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] was not able to get any information about the planet.<ref name="GNN3" /> The system was patrolled by an Imperial [[force superiority]]: three [[battle squadron]]s and a [[light squadron]], including three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Scourge (Victory I-class)|''Scourge'']].<ref name="TFOP" /> The only ship allowed to land on the surface was [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. The Princess lured Lord Tion and managed to contact the [[Ralltiir underground]] and get critical information about the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="CatCW" /> In the following weeks, the blockade severely impacted commerce and economy in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] and along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. However, after Tion's [[Death/Legends|death]], many [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were able to run the blockade successfully,<ref name="GNN3" /> and provide weapons to the rebellion.<ref name="GNN10" /><ref name="GNN10">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> After the subjugation of the planet, the blockade was lifted but Imperial forces stayed on Ralltiir.<ref name="CatCW" /> Anti-Imperial resistance remained strong on the planet in the next years and the blockade may have established temporarily, such as after the [[Crackdown on Ralltiir|crackdown]] in [[Salibury]], [[2 ABY/Legends|two years later]].<ref name="GNN10" /> The blockade ruined the planet and Ralltiiri economy was still recovering [[10 ABY/Legends|ten years after]].<ref name="CatCW" />
